messages:
Morgan: Heads-up team 14 quick micro-plan for social push around the Mar 26 webinar. Need fast turn on creative + two copy flavors.

Anya: I can draft captions. Two tones: 'data-first' and 'people-first'. Any preference for the LinkedIn hook?

Samir: Creative scope: GIF 1200x628, 1:1 static, 15s clipped highlight (16:9), two thumbnail options. Keep assets silent-first (caption burns).

Jamie: Assigned CR-5127. ETA Mon 16:00 PT for deliverables. Will include both thumbnails and alt-captions burned in.

Morgan: Posting cadence:
```
Tue 11:00 PT X teaser (GIF) + Variant 1
Tue 12:00 PT LinkedIn long form (stat + CTA)
Wed 09:00 PT X reminder
Wed -30m live thread w/ 3 replies (clip, FAQ, signup nudge)
```

Theo: Add UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_content={variant}. Also tag leads with webinar:mar26 + source:social + variant.

Riley: Ill wire UTMs and SFDC tags, plus an auto-DM flow for thread replies. SDRs get hot leads with 1h SLA. Send final reg URL asap.

Anya: Draft copy (first pass):
- Data-first: "Benchmark: 3x inference throughput in production. See the methods in our webinar 1 Register: <shortlink>"
- People-first: "Building reliable LLM features? Join us for real-world tactics and benchmarks. Save your spot: <shortlink>"

Samir: Reply script idea: "Reply 'clip' for a 15s highlight. We'll DM details + demo link." Riley will hook DM to auto-send clip + qualifier question.

LegalBot: Will review any specific stat phrasing within 4 hours of receiving the exact source link.

Morgan: Action recap: Jamie deliver assets by Mon 16:00 PT (CR-5127); Anya finalize copy + stat source by Mon EOD; Samir prep reply scripts; Riley wire UTMs + smoke test Mon 17:30 PT; Theo add tags/events; LegalBot review. Flag here if anything slips. :rocket:
